types.name: pnl.v1.DailyProfitAndLoss
types.doc: DailyProfitAndLoss is one UTC day of an account.

fields.name: day
fields.doc: The day, at 00:00 UTC.

fields.name: pnl_usd
fields.doc:
PnL in USD of the day: realized_pnl_usd plus the change in unrealized
 PnL from the previous day's close to this day's close, with transfers
 neutral. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is
 not available.

fields.name: realized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Realized PnL in USD of the day's trades, after fees. Signed base-10
 decimal string.

fields.name: unrealized_pnl_at_close_usd
fields.doc:
Unrealized PnL in USD of the holdings at the day's close. Signed base-10
 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available, as for
 today before it closes.

fields.name: fees_usd
fields.doc:
Fees paid in the day net of rebates, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal
 string.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc: Traded volume in the day, in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: trade_count
fields.doc: Fills of the account in the day.

fields.name: notices
fields.doc: What the day's figures leave out, if anything.

fields.name: start_equity_usd
fields.doc:
Equity in USD at 00:00 UTC that starts the day: every asset the account
 owns, funds reserved by open orders and pending withdrawals included,
 valued at the price at that time. It equals the previous day's
 end_equity_usd. Non-negative base-10 decimal string. Omitted with notice
 EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE when a price it needs is not available, or after a
 day with notice UNCLASSIFIED_TRANSFER or QUANTITY_SHORTFALL.

fields.name: end_equity_usd
fields.doc:
Equity in USD at 00:00 UTC that ends the day, valued as
 start_equity_usd. Omitted as start_equity_usd is, and for today until
 the day closes.

fields.name: net_flow_usd
fields.doc:
Net external flows of the day in USD: deposits and transfers in, minus
 withdrawals and transfers out, each valued at the USD price when it
 settled. Transfers between the main account and its own subaccounts
 count for a single subaccount and cancel out for the main account.
 Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a price it needs is not
 available.

types.name: pnl.v1.GetProfitAndLossRequest
types.doc: GetProfitAndLossRequest selects the account and period.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, a session or main-account
 API key reads the main account together with every subaccount it owns,
 and a subaccount API key reads its own subaccount. A main-account API key
 may name a subaccount its main account owns.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: window
fields.doc: Period to report.

fields.name: product
fields.doc:
Optional product filter; PROFIT_AND_LOSS_PRODUCT_UNSPECIFIED means every
 product.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc:
Optional market filter for markets; 0 means every market. Totals and
 holdings are not filtered by market.

types.name: pnl.v1.GetProfitAndLossResponse
types.doc: GetProfitAndLossResponse is the account's PnL over the period.

fields.name: window_start
fields.doc: Start of the period (UTC), inclusive.

fields.name: as_of
fields.doc:
When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades and transfers settled
 shortly before may not be included yet.

fields.name: mark_time
fields.doc:
Time of the prices that value holdings now (UTC): the close of the latest
 complete minute.

fields.name: pnl_usd
fields.doc:
PnL in USD over the period: realized_pnl_usd plus the change in
 unrealized PnL from the period's start to now, with deposits,
 withdrawals and transfers neutral. Signed base-10 decimal string.
 Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

fields.name: realized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after fees. Signed base-10
 decimal string.

fields.name: unrealized_pnl_change_usd
fields.doc:
Change in unrealized PnL in USD from the period's start to now, net of
 transfers in and out. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted when a
 price it needs is not available.

fields.name: unrealized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Unrealized PnL in USD of the holdings now. Signed base-10 decimal
 string. Omitted when a price it needs is not available.

fields.name: fees_usd
fields.doc:
Fees paid in the period net of rebates, in USD. Signed base-10 decimal
 string.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc:
Traded volume in the period, in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal
 string.

fields.name: products
fields.doc: PnL by product.

fields.name: markets
fields.doc: Realized PnL by market, ordered by symbol_id.

fields.name: holdings
fields.doc: Assets held now, ordered by asset_id.

fields.name: notices
fields.doc: What the figures leave out, if anything.

types.name: pnl.v1.GetTradingStatisticsRequest
types.doc: GetTradingStatisticsRequest selects the account and period.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID, selected as for
 GetProfitAndLossRequest.subaccount_id.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: window
fields.doc: Period to report.

fields.name: product
fields.doc:
Optional product filter; PROFIT_AND_LOSS_PRODUCT_UNSPECIFIED means every
 product.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Optional market filter; 0 means every market.

types.name: pnl.v1.GetTradingStatisticsResponse
types.doc:
GetTradingStatisticsResponse summarizes the account's trading in the
 period.

fields.name: window_start
fields.doc: Start of the period (UTC), inclusive.

fields.name: as_of
fields.doc:
When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades settled shortly
 before may not be included yet.

fields.name: trade_count
fields.doc: Fills of the account in the period.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc: Traded volume in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: fees_usd
fields.doc: Fees paid net of rebates in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: realized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after fees. Signed base-10
 decimal string.

fields.name: notices
fields.doc: What the figures leave out, if anything.

fields.name: return_pct
fields.doc:
Time-weighted return in percent over closed days only: for DAYS_7 and
 DAYS_30, the 7 or 30 closed UTC days ending at the latest 00:00 whose
 prices are final; every closed day for LIFETIME; none for TODAY. The daily returns are compounded, so
 deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains or losses. A day's return is (end - start - flow) / (start + flow / 2)
 of its equity and net flow; a day that starts with no equity starts at
 its first deposit, with return (end - flow) / flow. Signed base-10
 decimal string, such as "1.25" for 1.25%. The return figures cover the
 whole account, whatever symbol_id and product select. Omitted when a
 day's equity or net flow is not available, or when the period has no
 closed day.

fields.name: max_drawdown_pct
fields.doc:
Largest fall in percent of the compounded return from a previous peak,
 at day closes. Non-negative base-10 decimal string. Omitted as
 return_pct is.

fields.name: sharpe
fields.doc:
Annualized Sharpe ratio of the daily returns: their mean divided by
 their sample standard deviation, times the square root of 365, with no
 risk-free rate. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted with notice
 SHARPE_INSUFFICIENT_DAYS for fewer than 7 daily returns; omitted also
 when the returns do not vary, or as return_pct is.

fields.name: return_days
fields.doc:
Daily returns the return figures are based on: the closed days of their
 period from the account's first deposit on. Today never counts.

types.name: pnl.v1.HoldingProfitAndLoss
types.doc: HoldingProfitAndLoss is one asset the account holds now.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Asset ID.

fields.name: position_quantity
fields.doc:
Quantity held, in whole units of the asset: position_quantity =
 quantity with a known cost plus untracked_quantity. Non-negative base-10
 decimal string.

fields.name: untracked_quantity
fields.doc:
Quantity whose cost is unknown, such as deposited coins, in whole units
 of the asset. It never counts toward PnL. Non-negative base-10 decimal
 string.

fields.name: cost_usd
fields.doc:
USD cost of the quantity with a known cost: what it cost when acquired,
 fees in the asset included. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: entry_price_usd
fields.doc:
Average entry price in USD per unit: cost_usd divided by the quantity with
 a known cost. Omitted when no quantity has a known cost.

fields.name: mark_price_usd
fields.doc:
Current USD price per unit used for unrealized PnL. Omitted when not
 available.

fields.name: unrealized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Unrealized PnL in USD: the quantity with a known cost valued at
 mark_price_usd, minus cost_usd. Signed base-10 decimal string. Omitted
 when mark_price_usd is.

types.name: pnl.v1.ListDailyProfitAndLossRequest
types.doc: ListDailyProfitAndLossRequest selects the account and days.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID, selected as for
 GetProfitAndLossRequest.subaccount_id.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc: First day (UTC), inclusive: 00:00 UTC of a day.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Day after the last one (UTC), exclusive: 00:00 UTC of a day, at most 366
 days after start_time.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum days to return; 0 means 31. At most 366.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, the subaccount selector, start_time
 and end_time.

types.name: pnl.v1.ListDailyProfitAndLossResponse
types.doc:
ListDailyProfitAndLossResponse is a page of days, oldest first. Every day
 of the range is listed, days without activity included.

fields.name: days
fields.doc: Days, oldest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

fields.name: as_of
fields.doc:
When the figures were last published (UTC). Trades and transfers settled
 shortly before may not be included yet.

types.name: pnl.v1.MarketProfitAndLoss
types.doc: MarketProfitAndLoss is the realized side of one spot market in a period.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Market of the trades.

fields.name: product
fields.doc: Product of the market.

fields.name: realized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Realized PnL in USD of the period's trades, after their fees: each sale
 realizes its proceeds minus the average cost of what it sold, and each
 fee is a realized expense. Signed base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: fees_usd
fields.doc:
Fees paid in the period, net of rebates received, in USD. Signed base-10
 decimal string: negative when rebates exceed fees.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc:
Traded volume in USD: execution price times quantity, valued at the
 execution time. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: trade_count
fields.doc: Fills of the account in the market in the period.

types.name: pnl.v1.ProductProfitAndLoss
types.doc: ProductProfitAndLoss is the PnL of one product in the period.

fields.name: product
fields.doc: Product.

fields.name: realized_pnl_usd
fields.doc:
Realized PnL in USD of the product's trades in the period, after fees.
 Signed base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: fees_usd
fields.doc: Fees paid net of rebates in USD. Signed base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: volume_usd
fields.doc: Traded volume in USD. Non-negative base-10 decimal string.

types.name: pnl.v1.ProfitAndLossNotice
types.doc:
ProfitAndLossNotice qualifies the figures of a reply. A figure is never
 reported as zero for want of a price: it is omitted, or a notice says what
 it leaves out.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
No USD price was available at the time of some trades or transfers, so
 their effect is not in the USD figures. Their quantities still count.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_MARK_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
A current or period-start price is not available yet for some holdings:
 their unrealized PnL, and every figure that includes it, is omitted.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_UNCLASSIFIED_TRANSFER
values.doc: Some balance changes have an unrecognized reason and are not counted.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_QUANTITY_SHORTFALL
values.doc: Some sales exceeded the quantity PnL knows the account held.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The account's equity at a day's start or end is not available, so the
 equity figures and the returns that need them are omitted.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_FLOW_UNVALUED
values.doc:
No USD price was available for some deposits, withdrawals or transfers,
 so the day's net flow and the returns that need it are omitted.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_NOTICE_SHARPE_INSUFFICIENT_DAYS
values.doc:
Fewer than 7 daily returns are available in the period, so the Sharpe
 ratio is omitted. return_days says how many there are.

types.name: pnl.v1.ProfitAndLossProduct
types.doc: ProfitAndLossProduct is the trading product a PnL figure belongs to.

types.name: pnl.v1.ProfitAndLossWindow
types.doc:
ProfitAndLossWindow is the period a PnL read covers. Every window ends now
 and starts at 00:00 UTC of a day.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_WINDOW_DAYS_7
values.doc: Since 00:00 UTC six days ago: today and the 6 days before it.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_WINDOW_DAYS_30
values.doc: Since 00:00 UTC 29 days ago: today and the 29 days before it.

values.name: PROFIT_AND_LOSS_WINDOW_LIFETIME
values.doc: Since 00:00 UTC of the day of the account's first trade or transfer.
